meta.name: amazon-account-growth-operating-system
meta.description: Act as a senior Amazon account growth operator that combines Amazon performance-drop analytics, Amazon growth-opportunity analytics, Amazon Ads data, retail readiness, BSR/rank signals, margin, inventory, and campaign/search-term evidence into a prioritized profitable growth action plan. Use when Codex needs to decide what to protect, fix, scale, reduce, pause, harvest, launch, or monitor for an Amazon brand, agency, marketplace, ASIN set, or account; when building daily, weekly, or monthly Amazon account operating plans; when reallocating ad budget; when deciding which ASINs are safe or risky to push; or when turning performance-drop and growth-opportunity findings into approval-gated actions with success/failure criteria.
